The independent model has CHI at 67% while the no-vig market has CHI at 57% with the headline weighting the model at lambda 0.10. The gap is 0.2 SD, inside the disagreement threshold. Expected margin is CHI by 3.7 (10–90: -12.0 to +20.0 CHI) and the expected total is 234.3 (10–90: 211–261); projected score CHI 119.1, IND 113.5. Pace projects 103.5 possessions, +4.5 vs the league pace of 99.0; overtime probability 5.5%. The blended net-rating gap is +0.3 per 100 for CHI (player layer 0.0, results layer +0.6; the results layer carries more of it and the layers point in opposite directions). Context: League home-court advantage home +2.0 pts; Rest-day differential (per day, cap 3) 2 vs 0 days +1.8 pts; 2nd night of back-to-back IND 2nd night +1.5 pts; Travel miles last 72h (per 1,000) IND 166 mi +0.1 pts (shown, not in model).

IND at CHI already rules out Norman Powell (CHI), Caleb Wilson (CHI), T.J. McConnell (IND), Tyrese Haliburton (IND) and Ben Sheppard (IND), which is baked into every scenario. Jalen Smith (CHI) has a 70% play probability; CHI win probability goes from 67% if he plays to 66% if he sits (+0.8 pts), the spread moves -0.3 and the total 0.0, with Nic Claxton +3.7 min, +8.1 usage pts, +1.9 pts and Isaac Okoro +3.5 min, +6.4 usage pts, +1.6 pts absorbing the minutes if he sits. Across 2 lineup scenarios the entropy is 0.88 bits; the most likely branch (70%) is everyone available. Statuses resolve on the clock: the next official injury report slot is 8:30 AM ET and lineups are typically confirmed around 7:30 PM ET (T-30m before the 8:00 PM ET tip).
